quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #11
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: When turning left from a multilane, one-way street or highway, which lane should you start from?

options.text: The middle of the intersection.
The right lane.
The left lane.
Any lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane.
questions.explanation: To turn left from a multilane street or highway, you must start from the left lane.

questions.question: What does an arrow painted on the pavement mean?

options.text: Drivers in that lane may make the movement shown by the arrow if they choose to.
Drivers in that lane must make the movement shown by the arrow only if traffic lights are not working.
Drivers in that lane must always stop completely before making the movement shown by the arrow.
Drivers in that lane must make the movement shown by the arrow while following traffic signals.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers in that lane must make the movement shown by the arrow while following traffic signals.
questions.explanation: An arrow on the pavement shows drivers which direction they must go in that lane. Always follow traffic signs and signals before moving in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: What do orange signs mean?

options.text: Work zone signs.
Regulatory signs.
School zone signs.
Guide signs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Work zone signs.
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about work zones on the road. These diamond-shaped signs have black letters and symbols. They tell you that workers are on or near the highway.

questions.question: If two vehicles arrive at a four-way stop at the same time, what should happen?

options.text: The vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right.
The vehicle on the right must yield to the vehicle on the left.
Drivers must use hand signals to talk to each other.
One driver should go without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right.
questions.explanation: When two vehicles reach a four-way stop at the same time, the vehicle on the left must let the vehicle on the right go first.

questions.question: What should you do when passing other vehicles?

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
Honk your horn at least three times.
Move back into your lane within 10 feet of the other vehicle.
You don't need to use your turn signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
questions.explanation: Before passing, check your mirrors and blind spots. Use your turn signal before changing lanes. Move back into your lane when you can see the front of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.question: You see a sign that says "Reduced speed, 35 mph." What does this mean?

options.text: The new 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
The new 35 mph speed limit starts at the next speed limit sign.
You have plenty of time to slow down before the reduced speed zone.
You should slow to 35 mph only during bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: The new 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
questions.explanation: A "Reduced speed" sign tells you to slow down. The new speed limit on this sign starts right at the sign.

questions.question: What does a steady yellow light at an intersection mean?

options.text: Go.
Yield to other cars.
Slow down and prepare to stop.
Stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: A yellow light means a red light is coming soon. Slow down and be ready to stop. If you are already in the intersection or cannot stop safely, go through carefully.

questions.question: When can you go through an intersection with a stop sign but no stop line or crosswalk?

options.text: After slowing down to make sure there is no other traffic.
After coming to a complete stop and making sure it is safe.
After stopping at least 20 feet before the intersection.
After slowing down to 10 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: After coming to a complete stop and making sure it is safe.
questions.explanation: Stop at a stop sign even if there is no stop line or crosswalk. Only proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: Is it good to turn your head and check your blind spot before changing lanes or merging?

options.text: No, it's a bad habit.
Yes, it's a good habit.
No, it's not necessary.
No, not if you use your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yes, it's a good habit.
questions.explanation: Always check your blind spots by looking over your shoulder before changing lanes. Do not rely only on your mirrors.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: One-way traffic.
Intersection ahead.
Merging traffic from the right.
Highway curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Merging traffic from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is merging in from the right.

questions.question: A flashing red traffic signal means the same thing as:

options.text: A slow sign.
A yield sign.
A stop sign.
An intersection sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: A stop sign.
questions.explanation: When you see a flashing red signal, you must stop. Then yield to all other traffic that does not have to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A divided highway is starting.
A steep hill is ahead.
The bridge or overpass ahead is very low.
Two lanes of traffic are about to merge in opposite directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge or overpass ahead is very low.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the bridge or overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not drive through if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: When backing your vehicle, you should:

options.text: Use only your mirrors.
Flash your lights.
Open your door to see if it is safe.
Turn your head and look through the rear window.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look through the rear window.
questions.explanation: Always check behind your vehicle before backing up. Children and small objects are hard to see from the driver's seat. Turn your head to see through the rear window while backing. Do not rely only on mirrors or sensors.

questions.question: Triangular signs with the point facing down mean:

options.text: School zone ahead.
You must yield to other traffic.
Construction zone ahead.
Railroad crossing ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must yield to other traffic.
questions.explanation: Downward-facing triangular signs tell drivers to yield. Once the road is clear of traffic and pedestrians, you may proceed.

questions.question: A diamond-shaped sign tells you:

options.text: There is a hazard or danger ahead.
A school zone is ahead.
A public recreation area is ahead.
Food and gas are coming up.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a hazard or danger ahead.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn you about hazards or dangers ahead. These signs are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: At night, when another vehicle is coming toward you, your headlights should be:

options.text: On high beam.
On low beam.
Off. Use parking lights instead.
Either high or low beam.

questions.correctAnswerText: On low beam.
questions.explanation: Do not use high beam headlights when meeting or following another vehicle at night. Switch to low beam to keep everyone safe.

questions.question: When an emergency vehicle with flashing lights is near you, you should:

options.text: Speed up to get out of the way.
Stop and block the emergency vehicle from passing.
Clear the path for the emergency vehicle to pass.
Signal the emergency vehicle when it is safe to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Clear the path for the emergency vehicle to pass.
questions.explanation: Give the emergency vehicle a clear path to travel. If it is safe, pull to the side of the road to let the emergency vehicle pass.

questions.question: If a train is close or moving fast enough to be dangerous, you must:

options.text: Slow down and continue with care.
Not cross the tracks until the train completely passes.
Cross the tracks at your own risk.
Find another route across the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not cross the tracks until the train completely passes.
questions.explanation: Look and listen for trains before crossing railroad tracks. If a train is close or moving fast, do not cross. This is true even if there are no signals or they are not working.

questions.question: How alcohol affects your reflexes and judgment depends on:

options.text: Whether you drink beer instead of wine.
Whether you drink wine instead of beer.
Whether you drink hard cider or mixed drinks.
How much alcohol is in your blood.

questions.correctAnswerText: How much alcohol is in your blood.
questions.explanation: Any type of alcohol can harm your reflexes and judgment. The type of drink does not matter. Only the amount of alcohol in your bloodstream affects you.

questions.question: If a tire suddenly goes flat while you are driving, you should:

options.text: Hold the wheel tight and brake gently.
Press the accelerator.
Turn quickly off the road.
Brake hard and stop as fast as possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the wheel tight and brake gently.
questions.explanation: Hold the wheel tight and keep the vehicle straight. Slow down gradually by releasing the accelerator and use light braking. Drive to a safe spot off the road if you can.

questions.question: What driving technique helps you avoid crashes on icy or snowy roads?

options.text: Add extra weight to your vehicle for better grip.
Leave the highways as soon as possible.
Turn on four-wheel drive.
Drive slower and stay farther behind other cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive slower and stay farther behind other cars.
questions.explanation: Slow down on snowy or icy roads. Slowing down and increasing your distance from other cars are the best ways to avoid crashes in these conditions.

questions.question: When driving in rain, you must:

options.text: Use low beam headlights.
Use high beam headlights.
Use parking lights.
Use no lights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use your low beam headlights when it is raining.

questions.question: When driving near a motorcycle, you must:

options.text: Give the motorcycle a full lane.
Drive on the shoulder next to the motorcycle.
Let the motorcycle share half a lane with you.
Pass the motorcycle using the same lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the motorcycle a full lane.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle is a full vehicle with the same road rights as any other vehicle. Give motorcyclists a full lane width. Even if it looks like there is room to share, motorcycles need space to move safely.

questions.question: A solid yellow line on your side of the centerline means:

options.text: Slow down.
Pass with caution.
Do not pass.
Keep right on hills.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not pass.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line next to your lane means you cannot pass from your direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must turn left.
No left turn.
No U-turn.
Truck route to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that left turns are not allowed.
